import re

def is_valid(name):
    if not isinstance(name, str):
        return False
    if not (1 <= len(name) <= 32):
        return False
    # letters, digits, _, -
    if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$', name):
        return False
    return True

print(is_valid("test-user_1"))
print(is_valid("test user"))
print(is_valid("test@user"))
print(is_valid(""))
print(is_valid("a" * 33))
EOF
